zoo: A zoo is a park that people go to where live animals can be seen.
There are lions at our local zoo.
zombie: A zombie is type of fictional creature. It is a dead body that has been brought back to life. Usually a zombie moves slowly, growls, and will want to eat people's brains.
zoom: To change the focus of a zoom lens
zodiac: A belt-like area of the sky that the Sun, Moon, and the planets pass through; it extends about eight degrees north and south of the ecliptic, and is divided into 12 equal parts which are each named after a constellation.
The 12 signs, or houses, of the zodiac. Each sign is named after one of the constellations in the zodiac.
A circle decorated with the signs of the zodiac.
My friend has a tattoo of a zodiac.
zookeeper: A zookeeper is someone who works at a zoo and takes care of the animals.
We saw the zookeeper feeding the tiger in the zoo.
zoology: Zoology is the science of learning about animals.
He likes animals, so he wants to study zoology in university.
zone: A zone is an area that is known for a particular use.
You are in a no-smoking zone.
When you are in the zone, you are in a time of high performance.
If you zone something, you divide into it; you give it a particular use.
If you zone a property, you determine what the property will be used for.
zoroastrianism: Zoroastrianism is a religion founded by Zoroaster.
zoologist: A zoologist is a person who studies zoology.
zonal: If something is zonal, it is related to or arranged in zones.
zoological: Zoological specimens, medicine, studies, etc. relate to the study of animals.
He works at the city's zoological research centre.
A zoological park, society, garden, etc. is one related to a zoo.
The children visited the zoological gardens.
